author: packs
description: Starter segments (E7-T10): four stored queries over contacts (engaged in the last 90 days, new this month, unengaged for 6 months, and customers by lifecycle stage), to build a segment list from. The lists themselves are not shipped: writing them by key would need marketing_list to declare a business key, and a unique list name would stop the pack installing where two lists share a name.
name: marketing-starter-segments

definition.name: Engaged in the last 90 days
definition.sql: SELECT c.id FROM "contact" c WHERE c.is_active = true AND c.last_marketing_engagement_at > now() - INTERVAL '90 days'

definition.name: New this month
definition.sql: SELECT c.id FROM "contact" c WHERE c.is_active = true AND c.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())

definition.name: Unengaged for 6 months
definition.sql: SELECT c.id FROM "contact" c WHERE c.is_active = true AND (c.last_marketing_engagement_at IS NULL OR c.last_marketing_engagement_at < now() - INTERVAL '6 months')

definition.name: Customers
definition.sql: SELECT c.id FROM "contact" c WHERE c.is_active = true AND c.lifecycle_stage = 'customer'

title: Pack: starter segments
